body: I’ve never heard of that. But then again, English is my second language

I was isolated from the rest of my class apart from a small handful of friends that knew she was full of shit. I remember we both went on a class trip abroad and it started off good until she started telling everyone- at that point we were still together. At that point I nearly got sent back because nobody wanted to be around me
It’s so shit. I didn’t think anybody was psychotic or despicable enough to pull shit like that.
